prose: The dream team returns for a trip down the memory stream with Disney/Marvel's Moon Knight, episode 5: "Asylum." As we explore the fractured recollections of the collective mother-wound inflicted on humanity by pseudo-gnostic culture vultures, the symbolism will surely surprise you with its dark depths.
The Marvelous Demystifiers are: Chance Garton, Gabriel (Slick Dissident), Gordan Hamil.
